name: headless-cli-closed-loop
title: Headless CLI for closed-loop functional verification (real provider chain)
description: Build a headless CLI over AppContainer services to drive and assert the real end-to-end business chain (auth, upload, parse, knowledge tree, question generation, practice, report) against real configured providers (LLM/OCR/embedding/search/queue/storage), so the AI can self-verify functionality instead of relying on mocks. Stop and report if real-provider config is missing.
